policies: Do not use name similarity as proof of move mechanics.
Do not treat effect IDs as human-readable effects without validating the Project PM battle code or a verified effect table.
Do not mark the added moves as Gen IV-compatible solely because their records exist in a Platinum-based ROM.
Canonical effect symbols are candidate mappings from the pinned reference table only; they do not prove Project PM runtime behavior or move identity.
Move identity candidates remain hypotheses; do not expose them as verified move names until the Project PM name bank or battle code confirms them.
